## Aurevia Practice OS Outbound Campaign Engine

Production Webhook: POST /webhook/patient-campaign
Test Webhook: POST /webhook-test/patient-campaign

Enforces server-side guardrails:
1. Hard maximum 25 recipients per run
2. Daily limit defaults to 25 (configurable from Config sheet)
3. Cooldown window (7 days) and business hours (10 AM - 7 PM Asia/Kolkata)
4. Excludes opted out, invalid phone, already booked, contacted today, human handoff
5. Applies rate-limiting delay between WhatsApp sends
6. Returns standardized JSON response contract

nodes.name: 02 - Get Config
nodes.notes: Config is the source of truth for timezone, daily outbound limits, and booking URL. Keep key/value headers in row 1.

nodes.name: 03 - Get Patients
nodes.notes: Reads Patients rows for campaign eligibility. Requires patient_id, phone, preferred_channel, reactivation_eligible, opt_out, conversation_state, and last_treatment.

nodes.name: 04 - Get Active Offers
nodes.notes: Only active, date-valid Offers are eligible. Missing or ambiguous offer facts must stop the campaign rather than be invented.

nodes.name: 05 - Get Conversations Log
nodes.notes: Used for daily outbound counting and audit history. Keep conversation_id and message_id unique.
